Title: Package provenance and metadata DSL injection
Verification: Spoofed descriptor/foreign contribution/control-character and backend injection rejected; exact package identity and selected set verified
CompatibilityImpact: Plans compiled through the registry now carry opaque identity; direct string metadata no longer activates Wist modules
ResidualRisk: Low: registry identity remains in-process by design; serialized envelopes must be recompiled/reverified after load
Notes: Runtime accepts only registry-issued identity and compiled Wist-owned module selection.

Title: Conditions feature contract mismatch
Verification: if/else, boolean logic and comparisons execute through interpreter and CIL
CompatibilityImpact: Legacy wist.conditions remains an aggregate for one migration cycle
ResidualRisk: Low: consumers should migrate to split feature IDs

Title: Warn plus Null diagnostic sink
Verification: Strict/Warn/Off matrix and observable warning sink verified
CompatibilityImpact: Warn now requires a non-null observable sink; Off must be explicit
ResidualRisk: Low: hosts relying on silent Warn must configure a sink or Off
Notes: Execution override has priority; otherwise validated host defaults apply.

Title: Reentrant dispose self-deadlock
Verification: Reentrant dispose fails immediately; external concurrent dispose shares completion and waits for in-flight operations
CompatibilityImpact: Reentrant dispose changes from hang to InvalidOperationException
ResidualRisk: Low: AsyncLocal ownership assumes operations flow through the runtime gate

Title: Forged executable LanguagePlan
Verification: No public executable-plan constructor; canonical hash recalculated; routes and selected contributions verified before execution
CompatibilityImpact: Callers must compile/reverify instead of constructing LanguagePlan directly
ResidualRisk: Low: binary compatibility may require recompilation for callers that used the old public constructor
Notes: Verified plan is an opaque compiler product.

Title: Process-wide order-dependent ExtensibleEnum registry
Verification: Stable ordinal-name identity; scoped catalog freeze/duplicates/cross-catalog behavior verified
CompatibilityImpact: EnumGenerator insertion-index lookup removed; facade marked obsolete
ResidualRisk: Medium: callers of GetName(int) now receive NotSupportedException and must migrate
Notes: No process-wide mutable registration order participates in equality/hash.

Title: Reflection constructor declaration-order selection
Verification: Exact supported signatures selected deterministically; ambiguous/unsupported constructors rejected
CompatibilityImpact: Previously tolerated ambiguous providers now fail fast

Title: Silent interpreter conversion fallback
FilesChanged: RuntimeValueConversion.cs; InterpreterIntrinsicExecutor.cs; AbstractMethodsIntrinsicCompiler.cs; arithmetic/native call sites
Verification: Interpreter and CIL classify InvalidFormat, Overflow, Unsupported, Nullability and PrecisionLoss consistently
CompatibilityImpact: Invalid conversions now throw typed conversion failures instead of silently preserving a value
ResidualRisk: Low: code relying on silent fallback must handle errors
Notes: One shared conversion classifier/service owns the contract.

Title: SetAndList uniqueness violation
Verification: Add delegates to GetOrAdd; indexes rebuilt after removal; list/set snapshots stay consistent
CompatibilityImpact: Duplicate Add no longer appends a second value
Notes: Set semantics are preserved under add/remove/re-add.

Title: Generic Wist LanguagePack parity gap
Verification: Published machine-readable matrix blocks replacement claim; minimal-arithmetic executable parity verified
CompatibilityImpact: Generic pack is explicitly positioned as Wist subset alpha, not full replacement
ResidualRisk: High but bounded: six shipped presets and all optimizer routes remain Partial/Missing; legacy runtime must remain
Notes: Completion requires executable parity for every shipped preset/module/optimizer/policy.

Title: Static-state guardrail coverage gap
FilesChanged: StaticStateGuardrailTests.cs; static-state-exceptions.json; frozen lookup-table call sites
Verification: Roslyn analysis scans production C# syntax; mutable static collections rejected unless non-expired documented exception exists
CompatibilityImpact: New mutable static collections fail architecture tests
ResidualRisk: Low: syntax-based Roslyn inspection does not perform whole-program alias analysis
Notes: Known mutable tables were converted to frozen/immutable representations.

Title: Warning-only legacy API without removal gate
FilesChanged: LEGACY_DEPRECATION_REGISTRY.json; docs/migration/*; LanguageContracts.cs; LanguageDefinitionBuilder.cs; RuntimeContracts.cs; WistLanguageRuntimePack.cs
Verification: Unique gate IDs, owners, replacement, versions, usage assessment, exit criteria and parity gates validated
CompatibilityImpact: Legacy APIs remain available but carry stable deprecation IDs and bounded removal versions
ResidualRisk: Medium: downstream usage assessment is still required before warning-as-error/removal
Notes: Removal is mechanically blocked while F-10 replacementClaimAllowed=false.

Title: Typed runtime profile double text round-trip
Verification: Typed overlay conflict/duplicate/determinism tested; main execution path bypasses parser round-trip
Notes: Immutable overlay is applied directly to the compiled plan/profile.

Title: AIR verifier masks implementation defects
Verification: Expected domain violations remain contract diagnostics; unexpected exceptions become internal failures and cannot pass silent Warn path
CompatibilityImpact: Unexpected verifier defects now fail closed
Notes: Blanket catch is replaced by explicit domain/internal-failure handling.
